command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-cdp-shape.XXXXXX)
PORT=9388
PROD_BEFORE=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
cleanup(){ if [ -n "${CPID:-}" ] && kill -0 "$CPID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM -"$CPID" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$CPID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL -"$CPID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
echo PRODUCTION_BEFORE=$PROD_BEFORE
setsid /opt/google/chrome/chrome --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-web-security --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --remote-debugging-port=$PORT --remote-allow-origins='*' --user-data-dir="$TMP/profile" --window-size=746,449 --window-position=0,0 --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/ >"$TMP/stdout" 2>"$TMP/stderr" & CPID=$!
echo SCRATCH_PID=$CPID
for i in $(seq 1 80); do if curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/json/version >"$TMP/version.json" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep .1; done
echo '--- version ---'; cat "$TMP/version.json" || true
for delay in 0.2 1 3; do sleep $delay; echo "--- list after $delay ---"; curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/json/list || true; echo; done
echo '--- ps ---'; ps -o pid,ppid,pgid,stat,etimes,args -p $CPID || true
echo '--- stderr ---'; tail -80 "$TMP/stderr" || true
PROD_AFTER=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRODUCTION_DURING=$PROD_AFTER
test "$PROD_BEFORE" = "$PROD_AFTER"
echo CDP_TARGET_SHAPE_READONLY_PASS
